description: Who WON EU public contracts — searches contract-AWARD notices in Tenders Electronic Daily (TED), the official journal of the EU (2.8M+ award notices, all member states, back to 2011). Each result names the winning supplier(s), the awarded value with its currency, the buyer and country, CPV category, and award publication date. Use for "who won the X contract in Spain", "recent IT contract awards in France", "awarded construction contracts over 10M EUR". Filter by winner name, buyer name, CPV category (plain English or code), buyer country, winner country, value range, date window. Covers above-threshold EU procurement; values are as published by the buyer, normally excluding VAT.

buyer.description: Contracting authority name, matched partially ("Banedanmark", "Ville de Paris"). For a full buyer dossier use ted_buyer_profile instead.

category.description: Plain-English category resolved to CPV codes ("construction", "IT services", "medical equipment" — same vocabulary as search_notices). Use `cpv` if you already know the code.

country.description: Buyer country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 — FRA, DEU, ITA, ESP). Comma-separate several; they are OR-ed.

cpv.description: CPV code (8-digit or a shorter prefix, widened to the branch). Comma-separate several; they are OR-ed.

query.description: Free text searched across the full notice in any language (phrase first, then words-anywhere — same escalation as search_notices).

value_max.description: Awarded value ceiling (in the notice's own currency)

value_min.description: Awarded value floor (in the notice's own currency)

winner.description: Winning supplier name, matched partially ("Siemens" finds "Siemens Mobility A/S"). For a full supplier dossier use ted_supplier_history instead.

winner_country.description: Winner country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3). Comma-separate several; they are OR-ed.

name: ted_search_awards
title: Ted Search Awards
